run_concurrent_tasks: run multiple named tasks concurrently and collect results as a dictionary
run_tasks_with_timeout: run concurrent tasks with a timeout that raises TimeoutError on expiry
run_background_tasks: run tasks in background returning both successful results and errors separately
map_parallel_function: map a function across parallel argument lists and collect results in order
test_concurrency_module: test the concurrency module executor fail-fast behavior and task handling
